curriculumAdaptationNote: Preserve the exact supplier call, two boxes of roofing nails, plastic cap nails stock question, job-specification check, roofing cement plus sealant, supplier-provided delivery date and explicit order confirmation. Do not turn the glossary into a fastener-approval claim or invent tomorrow as the delivery date. Resolve roofing-cement formulation and specification semantics before selecting Japanese learner answers. Archived draft is evidence only; this packet creates no learner, audio, score or progress identity.
